name: delegation-board
description: A live pane of the session's subagents and teammates: type, model, effort, state, elapsed time, tokens, an optional cost estimate and the task description. It only observes; nothing leaves the machine.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: off (only the /board command, which says it is off) or on (observe the session's agents and keep the board).

open.title: Open the pane
open.description: spawn opens the pane at the first subagent of a session; never leaves it to the /board command.

prices.title: Prices
prices.description: Optional JSON object of dollars per million tokens, [input, output], keyed by a model id substring, for example {"sonnet": [3, 15]}. Cache reads and writes are priced as input. Unset, no cost is shown.
